children.text: Welcome to King Spa, the premier Korean day spa in Virginia, offering a unique blend of traditional wellness and modern luxury. As a family-owned sanctuary rooted in Korean tradition, we invite you to “come to heal and feel.” As the first Korean spa (jjimjilbang) in the U.S. and voted ‘Best Day Spa’ three years running by Northern Virginia Magazine, King Spa provides a sanctuary of healing through our detoxifying saunas, signature body scrubs, rejuvenating facials, and more. Each treatment is designed to leave you feeling rejuvenated, refreshed, and truly cared for.

children.html:
Vanessa Phillips
★★★★★
I can't recommend this place highly enough. My mom and I live fairly far apart but wanted a chill spa weekend together. It was phenomenal to meet up at Dulles, rent a car, and come to king spa! We really enjoyed the scrubs we got (would call a must experience if it's your first time), outdoor pool, and the environment in general. We were lucky enough to come when they have the spring promotion that if you buy entry + a service, another non-weekend entry is free.
Amanda The Traveler
★★★★★
Amazing Korean Spa with everything you may need! My husband and I went here to get away for a little while and I couldn't be happier with my experience! We were there for 6 hours, visited all of there many Sauna's, steam, ice, and relaxing rooms. And you can not forget there hot and warm pools! And when all is said and done you must visit their restaurant for some eggs, cold noodle soup, and shaved ice with red bean (trust me you'll love it!) As Korean spas go it is a pricier option, but we'll worth it given all of the options, if you're in the area you must try!
Deanna
★★★★★
I went to celebrate my birthday weekend and had a relaxing time. The staff was very helpful and give you a key fob for two separate lockers, one for your shoes and the other for your clothes/personal belongings. The nude pool in the locker rooms isn't my thing but it's available to those who are okay with that. The staff is constantly cleaning, which is a plus 👌🏾; keeps the facility nice and clean. The outdoor pools upstairs were nice and warm/hot. They have several different saunas and the food was good 😊. I didn't get to stay as long as I wanted since I had to leave by a certain time to fight the traffic. I would definitely return.
Megan Durst
★★★★★
I've gone with my small group multiple times and with my spouse and we all thoroughly enjoy it. I usually get the body scrub because who doesn't like their skin feeling like a baby's skin? And the ice bath has become one of my favorite parts, but I've always enjoyed the variety of saunas and bade pool, and the outdoor pool(and hot tub, and bridge) is beautiful & can be relaxing too(Just maybe not on a Saturday when it's busy😅). Definitely going back.
Mykyla J
★★★★★
This place was AMAZING, i stepped out of many comfort zones by going here. Things are a little confusing if you are getting the body scrub service, but there were other people there who helped even if the staff couldn't. Everybody was so friendly. I will continue to keep coming back. It's a 4 hour drive from where i stay, but it is worth the drive. I will also bring other people back along with me spreading the word of this amazing place !!!
Asel Dav
★★★★★
King Spa in Chantilly, VA, is a Korean-inspired spa offering a range of wellness and relaxation services. It features various saunas, including traditional Korean heated rooms, salt rooms, and cold rooms, designed to promote detoxification and relaxation. Additionally, King Spa offers body scrubs, massages, and other therapeutic treatments. The spa also includes amenities such as pools, relaxation lounges, and dining options, making it a comprehensive destination for a rejuvenating experience. This is my favorite place to relax… Highly recommend it, you will love this place ❤️

Are your facilities handicap accessible?

King Spa is committed to providing an inclusive experience for all our guests. We provide elevator access to all three floors of our spa. If you have specific needs or require additional assistance during your visit, please let our staff know, and we will be happy to accommodate you as best we can.

What is it like to visit a Korean spa (jimjilbang)?

Visiting a Korean spa, or jimjilbang, is a cultural experience focused on relaxation, socialization, and wellness. In the gender-segregated bathhouses, nudity is standard, and guests often walk around the locker rooms freely with little concern for modesty. This openness can be surprising for newcomers but is considered completely normal in a Korean spa setting. Small towels are provided but are mainly used for washing or covering the head, not the body. Keep in mind that visiting the nude bathhouse is optional and not required.

The atmosphere in a Korean spa is social and community-focused, with guests moving between saunas, lounges, the bathhouse, and relaxation areas. Families and friends often spend hours enjoying the amenities together.

Visiting a jimjilbang requires an open mind, but embracing the experience offers a deeper appreciation of Korean wellness culture.

Is nudity required at King Spa?

Nudity is only required in the gender-segregated bathhouses in the men’s and women’s locker rooms. Visiting this part of the spa is optional and not required. Comfortable spa uniforms are provided during your visit while you explore our other spa facilities.

What is the price of admission?

Please see our pricing page for current information on pricing.

What does admission give me access to?

Your daily admission pass includes access to: 

  • Locker Room
  • Bathhouse (steam room, cold plunge pool, hot tubs, showers)
  • Saunas
  • Rooftop Bade Pool
  • Indoor Aqua Pool & Waterfall
  • Jacuzzis
  • Media Room & Indoor Lounges

Your pass also includes:

  • Day Spa uniforms (all sizes available. Must be worn during your visit)
  • Complimentary toiletries
  • Towels

Please Note:

  • Remember to bring your bathing suit if you plan to visit our outdoor or indoor bade pools (you cannot enter these pools without appropriate swimwear).
  • Korean Spa treatments, products, food & beverages are available for an additional fee
  • You cannot leave our facility once you have entered. Please remember to bring all your belongings with you BEFORE entering the spa.
What are King Spa's hours?

King Spa is open 365 days a year, including holidays.

King Spa’s hours of operation:

  • Sunday – Thursday 9AM to 11PM
  • Friday & Saturday 9AM to 12AM

Outdoor pool hours: 

  • Sunday – Thursday 10 AM – 10 PM
  • Friday – Saturday 10 AM –  11 PM

Doors will close promptly at closing time, so we kindly ask that you plan to exit the building by then.

Do I need to make an appointment to visit the spa?

No, you don’t need an appointment to visit King Spa and enjoy our facilities like saunas, pools, and relaxation areas. However, appointments are required for treatments and must be made on-site on a first-come, first-served basis.

What should I bring with me?

Please bring a valid government-issued photo I.D. (pictures of ID’s and foreign driver’s licenses will not be accepted) as it is required for entry to King Spa. If you plan to use the bade pools, don’t forget to bring a swimsuit. An official King Spa uniform will be provided upon arrival for use in designated areas.

What is the dress code?

King Spa provides spa uniforms during your visit. Outside clothing is prohibited inside our spa and nudity is required in our gender-segregated bathhouse/shower area.

Are children allowed at King Spa?

Children under the age of 12 are not permitted under any circumstances. Minors under 17 years old must be accompanied by a legal guardian of the same gender. A maximum of 3 minors per adult of the same gender will be permitted.

Minors will need a copy of their school ID or birth certificate.

How long can I stay at King spa?

You are welcome to enjoy the spa facilities for the entire day with the purchase of a day pass. You can take your time moving through the various wellness zones and treatments at your own pace.

What type of spa treatments are available at King Spa?

We offer many relaxing and rejuvenating spa treatments for men, women, and couples at King Spa, including massages, facials, body scrubs, V-steams, and more. Explore King Spa’s luxurious spa treatments and book yours when you visit us. All treatments are booked on-site and are first-come, first-served.
